description: Defines data structures, constants, and function prototypes for configuring and analyzing TDD UL-DL patterns in 5G NR (3GPP TS 38.331), including pattern structures, slot calculations, and slot search functions.

classes.name: tdd_ul_dl_pattern
classes.description: Represents a TDD UL-DL pattern with slot and symbol counts for DL and UL directions.

classes.name: tdd_ul_dl_config_common
classes.description: Holds common TDD UL-DL configuration parameters, including reference SCS and pattern instances.

methods.name: nof_slots_per_tdd_period
methods.description: Calculates total number of slots in a TDD period based on the configuration.

methods.name: nof_full_dl_slots_per_tdd_period
methods.description: Calculates total number of fully DL-active slots in a TDD period.

methods.name: nof_dl_slots_per_tdd_period
methods.description: Calculates total number of slots with DL symbols in a TDD period.

methods.name: nof_full_ul_slots_per_tdd_period
methods.description: Calculates total number of fully UL-active slots in a TDD period.
